detail.description: A substantial four bedroom home set on a quiet cul de sac in the heart of Forrest Hill. With three bathrooms and generous off street parking for up to four vehicles, the floor plan suits growing families and those who like to entertain. Forrest Hill is one of the North Shore's most tightly held pockets, prized for its proximity to Milford and Takapuna beaches, the motorway, and some of Auckland's strongest schools. Offered for sale by negotiation. Contact Harrison for the full information pack and a private viewing.
